Timeline

[edit]
2015
  • September 10th - Conquest sign Sponsorless. ShahZaM, daps, ryx, Rush, and NAF-FLY join. [1]
  • October 18th - ryx announces he will no longer be playing with Conquest due to problems with teammates[2]
  • October 22nd - Conquest officially announce the addition of stanislaw to the main roster, as well as pauLy as coach [3]
  • December 5th - Conquest parts ways with pauLy. [4]
  • December 23rd - Players have parted ways with Conquest. [5]
